# Copilot Instructions — Drupal + Astro + Cloudflare Starter Kit

## Big picture
- Static-first stack: **Drupal 11 (DDEV, local only)** → **JSON:API** → **Astro SSG** → **Cloudflare Pages**.
- Build-time fetching only; production has **no Drupal runtime dependency**.
- Frontend consumes JSON:API via `jsona` + `drupal-jsonapi-params` (see `templates/astro-src/lib/drupal.ts`).

## Critical workflows
- One-time setup: `setup.sh` → `setup/cli.js` → `setup/ui.js` (Ink + execa). This creates `drupal-backend/` and `astro-frontend/` (not committed).
- Dev: `cd drupal-backend && ddev start && ddev launch` then `cd astro-frontend && npm run dev`.
- Build: `cd astro-frontend && npm run build` (requires DDEV running).
- Deploy: `./scripts/deploy-frontend.sh` (wrangler Pages deploy).

## Project conventions & patterns
- `.env` is generated from `.env.example`; `PROJECT_NAME` drives URLs:
  - `http://{PROJECT_NAME}.ddev.site` (Drupal), `/jsonapi` API, `https://{PROJECT_NAME}.pages.dev` (Pages).
- Homepage is controlled by `HOMEPAGE_ALIAS` (default `/home`); build duplicates `/home` → `/`.
- Static routing uses `getStaticPaths()` in `src/pages/[...slug].astro` (generated by setup).
- Astro config is static (`output: 'static'`) — no SSR adapter.

## Integration points
- Drupal JSON:API endpoint: `/jsonapi` (requires Pathauto/aliases for route generation).
- Cloudflare Pages config: `astro-frontend/wrangler.jsonc`.
- CI/CD (see `docs/github-actions.md`) uses `CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN` and `CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID`.

## Tooling & audits
- Audit toolkit in `audit/` is non-mutating and emits schema-backed reports.
  - Example: `npm run audit:all` (schema: `specs/001-project-audit-optimization/contracts/audit-report.schema.json`).
